column1: # title: ENG-205 Beowulf Part 2 — 3 Numbers & Dates
# topic: Beowulf Part 2 (Another Attack to Another Celebration at Heorot)

column2: Hrothgar says the haunted mere lies only "a few miles from here" (around line 1362).

column1: The best part of a day
column2: Beowulf swam down for "the best part of a day" before he could see the bottom of the mere (around line 1495).
Grendel's mother had "scavenged and gone her gluttonous rounds" in the mere "for a hundred seasons" (around line 1499).
Beowulf cut off Grendel's head to repay the night Grendel ate fifteen of Hrothgar's house-guards and carried off as many again (around line 1581).
At "the ninth hour of the day," the Danes left the cliff-top first and Hrothgar went home, while the Geats stayed staring at the mere for their lord (around line 1600).
It was "a task for four" to hoist Grendel's head on a spear and carry it to Heorot (around line 1637).
Fourteen Geats in fine fettle marched back to Heorot around Beowulf (around line 1641).
Hrothgar says he "ruled the Ring-Danes' country for fifty years" before Grendel turned his bliss to grief (around line 1770).
Beowulf promises to "land with a thousand thanes" to help Hrothgar if enemies ever threaten Denmark (around line 1829).
At the farewell Hrothgar gave Beowulf "twelve treasures" and told him to sail home safely and return soon (around line 1867).
